title: -지 않아도 되다 no obligación
part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태
chapter: Deseo, obligación, permiso y capacidad — 희망·의무·허가·능력
articleMarkdown:
#### En pocas palabras

The NIKL grammar report explicitly states that the negative forms of **-어도 되다** are **-지 않아도 되다** and **안 -어도 되다**; it illustrates both with **밥을 먹지 않아도 돼요**, **커피를 마시지 않아도 돼요**, and **커피를 안 마셔도 돼요**. It distinguishes these as permission not to perform an action (absence of obligation) from **-(으)면 안 되다**, which expresses prohibition. The distinction is contextual: “no tienes que” does not mean “está prohibido”.

#### Fuentes y localizadores

National Institute of Korean Language. Research on the Development of Korean Grammar and Expression Content (Stage 2), PDF pp. 491–492 (printed pp. 483–484): sentence-structure information and examples for -지 않아도 되다 / 안 -어도 되다; contrast with -(으)면 안 되다.

#### Entradas relacionadas

Se relaciona con **-아/어야 하다**, que expresa obligación, y con **-(으)면 안 되다**, que expresa prohibición. También deriva funcionalmente de **-아/어도 되다**, construcción de permiso.
